title: PaperTrail Evaluation Dataset v2
description: Ground-truth evaluation items for passage-level retrieval with evidence phrase verification.

id.description: Unique identifier for the evaluation item.

document.description: Filename of the target PDF document (must exist in papers/ folder or project root).

question.description: The question to retrieve evidence for.

answerable.description: True if the question is answerable from the document, false otherwise.

expected_page_numbers.description: 1-based page numbers where the answer can be found. Empty array when answerable is false.

evidence_phrase.description: A short exact string that appears in the correct passage on the expected page. Null when answerable is false.
